name: io.github.iowarp/plot-mcp
title: CLIO Plot
description: Draw line, bar, scatter, histogram, heatmap and time-series plots from tabular data.

tools.name: line_plot
tools.description: Create a line plot from CSV or Excel data with customizable styling.

tools.name: bar_plot
tools.description: Create a bar chart from CSV or Excel data, one bar per x value. Rows that share an x value are averaged (mean of y; the result reports aggregated=true and the y axis is labelled 'mean <y>'), keeping the 20 largest means; a file with one row per x value is plotted as-is (aggregated=false). For any other statistic, aggregate first and plot that file.

tools.name: scatter_plot
tools.description: Create a scatter plot from CSV or Excel data for correlation analysis.

tools.name: histogram_plot
tools.description: Create a histogram from CSV or Excel data showing value distribution.

tools.name: heatmap_plot
tools.description: Create a correlation heatmap from numeric columns in CSV or Excel data.

tools.name: plot_timeseries
tools.description: Create a multi-series line chart PNG from one or more y columns of a CSV or Excel file, auto-detecting a time, numeric, or categorical x axis.

tools.name: data_info
tools.description: Get schema, column types, and summary statistics for a CSV or Excel file.

resources.name: available_styles
resources.description: Available matplotlib plot styles and color palettes.

prompts.name: create_visualization
prompts.description: Guided workflow for creating a data visualization.
